profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP
profile.geoLocationName: Queens County, New York, United States
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Bloomberg currently working with the Product Master & Marketplace team within the Software Infrastructure department. Passionate about the web, its reach, and how to create amazing experiences delivered in sub-second speeds. I thrive on improving user experiences, generating and analyzing meaningful data, and attacking scaling problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Working on the next generation cloud ready software called IBM DataStage Flow Designer and to fulfill the mission statement of the Unified Governance and Integration group in IBM

Using Java to write REST APIs to build multiple tools that aid in data transformation

Learn and work on features involving Apache Spark, Machine Learning, Dockers and GitHub as the product supports a wide variety of engine and repositories.

Maintain high quality through unit testing, manual testing of various flows when a feature / fix is addressed.

Practice agile methodologies to deliver self-contained working pieces of code that can be delivered on demand and adapt fast and easy to any change in product plan.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked in an Agile, collaborative environment across the entire system architecture for the DataStage team. Designed and supported scalable  products in React JS and Java from backend to frontend.

Enabled continuous deployment and availability by designing, developing, and creating automated frameworks, processes and test cased based on functional and non-functional requirements using Selenium and Java.

Contributed functionality to the React Frontend, writing Jest unit test cases to ensure product functionality and correct design flaws.

positions.title: CUNY Tech Prep Software Development Fellow
positions.description:
- Completed a year-long, intensive full stack web development and software engineering boot camp for CUNY computer science students
- Learned and applied modern web technologies, such as React, Node, and Express, as well as tools and processes for design, implementation, testing, and deployment of software, with a focus on web applications
- Designed, developed, and presented web applications utilizing the Scrum development framework

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: 1 Gustave L. Levy Place New York, NY
positions.description:
Created an informative website that shares information on psychosis and cognitive behavioral therapy with the parents of patients suffering from psychosis, using React and Firebase.

Built a virtual simulation with React that focuses on submerging the user into an adolescent's experience suffering from psychosis where the user can interact with the adolescent through multiple choices at the end of every scene of the simulation.

honors.title: International Baccalaureate Diploma Recipient
honors.description: The IB Diploma Programme is a challenging two-year curriculum. Juniors and Seniors take six courses in the following subject groups: language; second language; experimental sciences; the arts; math and computer science; and individuals and societies. IB students also engage in 3 core requirements: an extended essay (4,000 words); Theory of Knowledge (interdisciplinary course); and creativity, action, service (community service).

projects.title: Multi-Cycle CPU
projects.description: A CPU design that allows the user to execute instructions in several clock cycles, as opposed to the Single Cycle CPU, which is constrained to executing every instruction in 1 clock cycle.

projects.title: Single Cycle CPU
projects.description: I designed and implemented a Single Cycle CPU capable of performing 14 operations.
